0022600127.text: The Warriors (0-2, 3rd in the Pacific and 13th in the West) make their fourth game of the season a road trip to the Nuggets (0-1, 5th in the Northwest and 11th in the West), with Golden State on a two-game losing streak. Listed as out for Golden State are Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Stephen Curry, while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo, Cameron Johnson, Julian Strawther and Spencer Jones. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on March 29, 2026, in Denver, where the Warriors lost 116-93.
